title: 未命名草稿087未命名086
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
片刻后，他眉头微微蹙起，神色凝重开口：“后山地底的确有一条雄厚灵脉，如今灵脉躁动紊乱，封禁大阵阵纹遭外力侵蚀破损，地底深处涌出的阴煞之气并非天然形成，而是带着浓郁的异域邪煞气息，与先前在青云仙宗遗址遭遇的异族煞气同源。而且山林外围，至少潜伏着七八名异族修士，修为最低皆是元婴巅峰，其中还有两道气息达到化神初期，隐匿行踪，死死盯着后山禁地，伺机而动。”
众人闻言，心头皆是一沉。
连叶辰都亲口确认有化神初期异族潜伏，局势远比众人想象的还要凶险。
陶渊面色难看，沉声说道：“若是任由煞气外泄，不出三日，便会弥漫整个陶家领地，污染周遭灵脉，伤及族人弟子。若是异族趁机闯入禁地，夺取灵脉秘宝，后果更是不堪设想！”
陶岚目光看向叶辰与玄真尊者，拱手恳切道：“玄真尊者，李长老，如今事态紧急，我陶家人手虽多，却无顶尖强者坐镇压制煞气、抵御异族。还望二位出手相助，稳定后山大阵，驱逐域外异族，我陶家必有重谢！”
如今局势危急，陶家虽长老不少，却无人能稳压化神初期异族，也难以修复残破的封禁大阵，只能求助于玄真尊者和战力超绝的叶辰。
席间各大宗门、世家之人也纷纷看向玄真尊者与叶辰，等着他们做出决断。
玄真尊者看向叶辰，示意由他做主。
叶辰目光望向后山方向，隐隐能感受到那股躁动的灵脉与森然的邪煞气息，沉吟片刻，缓缓开口：“域外异族觊觎大陆灵脉古址，步步蚕食，已然成为各方隐患。今日既然被我遇上，便不能坐视不理。也罢，我便随陶家诸位一同前往后山，稳住大阵，平息灵脉躁动，驱逐异族邪祟。”
他本就对域外异族极为反感，一路行来屡次遭遇异族为祸，如今对方潜伏陶家后山图谋不轨，他自然不会袖手旁观。
云游尊者见状，也起身道：“异族为祸，事关整个炎黄大陆安稳，我逍遥仙宗也不能置身事外，老夫也一同前往，助一臂之力。”
有两位顶尖强者出手，众人顿时安心不少。
陶渊大喜过望，连忙拱手道谢：“多谢玄真尊者、李长老、云游尊者仗义出手，我陶家感激不尽！”
“事不宜迟，即刻动身前往后山禁地，迟则恐生变故。”叶辰沉声说道。
他日，他必将脚踏朱雀，焚天煮海，俯瞰天下，成为这修仙界的至尊霸主！
南宫世家的弟子们身披火红战甲，手持神兵，分列两侧，气息强悍，眼神锐利，维持着现场秩序。
天空之上，不时有飞行妖兽掠过，留下一道道流光，各大势力的掌权者，纷纷带着门下弟子，赶赴此地。
栾傲雪、水轻舞、阮诗诗、玄真尊者、沧海真君等人，也早早来到圣殿之外，静静等候。
所有人的目光，都聚焦在前方那座巍峨耸立、直插云霄的古老圣殿之上。
朱雀圣殿，通体由赤焰神石铸就，高达十万丈，耸入云端，气势磅礴，威严无比。

殿身之上，雕刻着亿万只朱雀图腾，栩栩如生，展翅欲飞，每一道图腾都铭刻着古老符文，流淌着璀璨红光，散发着源自上古时期的厚重与神圣。
圣殿顶端，一轮巨大的朱雀虚影盘旋飞舞，火焰缭绕，天威浩荡，即便相隔甚远，也能让人感受到灵魂深处的悸动与敬畏。
这里，便是南宫世家的根基所在，是整个朱雀城最神圣、最核心的禁地。
“时辰已到，朱雀圣殿，开启！”
一声苍老而威严的大喝，从圣殿前方传来。
南宫世家当代家主，南宫鸿，身着赤金长袍，周身合体境巅峰威压弥漫，缓步走出。
在他身后，南宫烈、南宫凤，以及诸位核心长老、嫡系子弟，分列两侧，气势恢宏。
众人目光齐刷刷望去，瞬间屏住了呼吸。
只见南宫鸿缓缓抬起右手，指尖掐诀，口中念念有词。
刹那间，天地变色，灵气沸腾！
圣殿之上，亿万道朱雀符文同时亮起，绽放出万丈红光，直冲云霄。
轰隆隆——
震耳欲聋的巨响传遍四方，大地剧烈震颤。
圣殿那扇高达千丈的古老殿门，缓缓开启。
门开的瞬间，一股无比精纯、无比狂暴的火灵力，如同火山喷发一般，汹涌而出，席卷天地！
空气中，红色灵气粒子浓郁到化作实质，漫天飞舞，深吸一口气，都能让人修为暴涨。
更有一缕缕古老而神秘的神兽气息，弥漫开来，滋养着在场每一个人的神魂。
“好浓郁的火灵力！”
“这就是朱雀圣殿的气息吗？太恐怖了！”
“若是能在此修炼一月，我的修为必定能突破一个大境界！”

众人激动不已，眼神炽热，呼吸急促，恨不得立刻冲入圣殿之中。
南宫鸿目光扫过全场，威严开口：

After a moment, he frowned slightly and spoke solemnly: "There is indeed a strong spiritual vein under the Houshan Mountain. Now the spiritual veins are restless and disordered. The sealing formations have been eroded and damaged by external forces. The evil spirit gushing out from the depths of the ground is not naturally formed, but contains a strong foreign evil spirit. The auras have the same source as the alien evil spirits encountered at the Qingyun Immortal Sect ruins. Moreover, there are at least seven or eight alien monks lurking outside the mountain forest, all of whom are at the peak of Nascent Soul. There are two auras that have reached the early stage of divine transformation, hiding their whereabouts, staring at the forbidden area in the back mountain, waiting for opportunities. "
When everyone heard this, their hearts sank.
Even Ye Chen personally confirmed that there were aliens from the early stages of becoming gods lurking, and the situation was far more dangerous than everyone imagined.
Tao Yuan looked ugly and said in a deep voice: "If the evil energy is allowed to leak out, within three days, it will permeate the entire Tao family territory, pollute the surrounding spiritual veins, and harm the clan disciples. If an alien takes the opportunity to break into the forbidden area and seize the secret treasure of the spiritual veins, the consequences will be even more disastrous!"
Tao Lan looked at Ye Chen and Venerable Xuanzhen, raised her hands and said sincerely: "Venerable Xuanzhen, Elder Li, the situation is urgent now. Although our Tao family has many hands, we don't have top experts to suppress the evil spirits and resist the aliens. I hope that you two can help me stabilize the back mountain formation and expel the aliens from the region. I, the Tao family, will be very grateful!"
Now the situation is critical. Although there are many elders in the Tao family, no one can stabilize the alien race in the early stages of becoming gods, and it is difficult to repair the broken sealing formation. They can only turn to Venerable Xuanzhen and Ye Chen, who has extraordinary combat power.
During the banquet, people from various major sects and aristocratic families also looked at Venerable Xuanzhen and Ye Chen, waiting for them to make a decision.
Lord Xuanzhen looked at Ye Chen and indicated that he would make the decision.
Ye Chen looked toward the back mountain, and could faintly feel the restless spiritual veins and the formidable evil aura. He pondered for a moment, and then slowly said: "The foreign races from outside the territory are coveting the ancient spiritual vein sites of the mainland, and they are encroaching step by step, and they have become a hidden danger for all parties. Since I encountered it today, I can't just sit back and ignore it. Forget it, I will go to the back mountain with everyone from the Tao family, stabilize the formation, calm the restless spiritual veins, and drive away the evil spirits of the alien races."
He was extremely disgusted with foreign races from outside the region, and he had encountered troubles caused by foreign races many times along the way. Now that they were lurking in the back of the Tao family and plotting evil, he naturally would not stand by and watch.
Seeing this, Venerable Yunyou also stood up and said: "The alien race is causing trouble, and it is related to the stability of the entire Yanhuang Continent. I, the Xiaoyao Immortal Sect, cannot stay out of the matter. I will also go together to help."
With two top experts taking action, everyone immediately felt at ease.
Tao Yuan was overjoyed and quickly raised his hands to express his thanks: "Thank you, Venerable Xuanzhen, Elder Li, and Venerable Yunyou for your generous help. I, the Tao family, can't thank you enough!"
"It's not too late to leave for the forbidden area in the back mountain immediately. If you are too late, something may happen." Ye Chen said in a deep voice.
In the future, he will step on the red bird, burn the sky and cook the sea, overlook the world, and become the supreme overlord of this world of immortality!
The disciples of the Nangong family were wearing fiery red battle armor and holding magic weapons. They were arranged on both sides. Their auras were strong and their eyes were sharp, maintaining order on the scene.
In the sky, flying monsters flew past from time to time, leaving streaks of light behind. The leaders of the major forces rushed here with their disciples.
Luan Aoxue, Shui Qingwu, Ruan Shishi, Venerable Xuanzhen, True Lord Canghai and others also arrived outside the temple early and waited quietly.
Everyone's eyes were focused on the towering ancient temple in front of them, reaching into the sky.
The entire body of the Suzaku Temple is made of red flame sacred stone. It reaches a height of 100,000 feet and towers into the clouds. It is majestic and majestic.
On the temple body, there are hundreds of millions of red bird totems carved, lifelike and ready to fly. Each totem is engraved with ancient runes, flowing with bright red light, exuding the heaviness and sacredness originating from ancient times.
At the top of the temple, a huge phantom of the Suzaku hovered and danced, flames swirled, and the power of the sky was so majestic that even if it was far away, people could feel the throbbing and awe deep in their souls.
thisHere is the foundation of the Nangong family, and it is the most sacred and core forbidden area in the entire Suzaku City.
"The time has come, the Suzaku Temple is open!"
An old and majestic shout came from the front of the temple.
The current head of the Nangong family, Nangong Hong, was dressed in a red gold robe, filled with the pressure of the peak body fit state, and walked out slowly.
Behind him, Nangong Lie, Nangong Feng, as well as the core elders and direct descendants, lined up on both sides with magnificent momentum.
Everyone looked at it and held their breath for a moment.
I saw Nangong Hong slowly raising his right hand, making secrets with his fingertips, and muttering something in his mouth.
In an instant, the sky and the earth changed color, and the spiritual energy boiled!
Above the temple, billions of Suzaku runes lighted up at the same time, bursting into red light and shooting straight into the sky.
Rumble——
A deafening loud noise spread in all directions, and the earth shook violently.
The thousand-foot-tall ancient temple door of the temple slowly opened.
The moment the door opened, an extremely pure and violent fire spirit power surged out like a volcano erupting, sweeping across the world!
In the air, the red aura particles are so dense that they turn into substance, flying all over the sky. Taking a deep breath can make people's cultivation skyrocket.
There are also wisps of ancient and mysterious aura of mythical beasts, permeating the air, nourishing the souls of everyone present.
"What a rich fire spirit!"
"Is this the aura of the Suzaku Temple? It's too terrifying!"
"If I can practice here for a month, my cultivation will definitely break through to a great level!"
Everyone was extremely excited, their eyes were blazing, their breathing was rapid, and they wanted to rush into the temple immediately.
